exports.description: Archived apps whose disk image gets a Sparkle feed

archive.description: The .xcarchive whose app states its Sparkle feed in SUFeedURL

folder.description: Folder holding the disk image of that app

key.description: Variable holding the Sparkle EdDSA private key generate_appcast signs with

bucket.description: Variable holding the R2 bucket the feed is uploaded to

appcast.description: Variables naming the Sparkle key and the R2 bucket of the feed

dryRun.description: Prints each change and makes none, as NX_DRY_RUN=true does

__unparsed__.description: Words after -- of the run, appended after the configured arguments

title: Release publish
description: Signs a Sparkle feed for each disk image an export folder holds with generate_appcast under the key appcast.key names, pointing at the image's asset on the GitHub release nx release tags the archived app's version with, and uploads it to the R2 bucket appcast.bucket names at the path of the app's SUFeedURL with cf r2 objects put, and where a folder holds no disk image or either variable is unset names what is missing and publishes nothing; runs through nx release publish
